name: Sri Lanka
overview:
Separated only by a strait, Sri Lanka is a world apart from the mainland subcontinent. Calmness prevails on the island, one that feels hard-earned after decades of civil war. 

If the misty hills and balmy shores weren’t enchanting enough, the delightful Sri Lankan smiles that greet you across the island will assuredly leave you feeling fuzzy.

seo.title: Sri Lanka travel guide | Pareto Travel
seo.description: Explore Sri Lanka with a five-day itinerary through Sigiriya, Ella, Mirissa, and Colombo, seasonal guidance, and inter-city travel routes.
